label: founder or co-founder of
definition: Person or organization X founded or co-founded organization, institution, business, movement, or polity Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit founder or co-founder; founded or established Y in the institutional-creation sense; historical founding. Excludes: ownership or managerial office alone; merely joined or acquired an existing organization; discovery or finding an object; proposed founding without realization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: an incomplete institution or polity argument; a creator or builder phrase without clear institutional founding; unclear who is the founder. Founding is separate from holding an office or retaining ownership. The direction is founder to founded institution.
